'''Szeged-Csanád Grosics Akadémia''' is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club located in [[Szeged]], [[Hungary]]. The team's colors are [[Black (color)|black]] and [[Blue (color)|blue]] and they play their home matches at the [[Szent Gellért Fórum]]. The club, owned by the [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Szeged–Csanád]], was named after the legendary Hungarian goalkeeper [[Gyula Grosics]]."}}
